criteria: Validated behaviour untouched: the diff does not reach the code those behaviours depend on.
Adjacent: the diff touches shared code, but the preserved behaviours have direct coverage.
Likely breakage: the diff changes code a preserved behaviour depends on, with no coverage of it.
risk_of_regression.instructions: How likely is this diff to break a behaviour listed in `plan.preserve`? The order of the levels is the scale.

stuck_repeating_prior_failure.instructions: Is this attempt repeating an approach that is listed in `prior_failures` as already tried and failed?

touches_out_of_scope.instructions: Does the diff change anything the plan's `out_of_scope` list excludes?

 On open, and after every post, run that line with `--wait --wait-timeout 3500` in the foreground. One wait at a time. Act on the exit code (A2A-Hub Loop 13, master 8e59f58, `docs/loops/loop-13-design-ruling.md`): exit 0, a turn was printed, act on it (the atlas turn, in this same turn). Exit 1, refused or called wrong: fix the call and do not retry. Exit 2, the window elapsed: wait again. Exit 3, unavailable or throttled: the last stderr line is `[hub-talk] retry status=<code|network> retry-after=<seconds|unknown>`; wait `retry-after` seconds, otherwise back off 5 s doubling to 60 s; after 5 consecutive exit-3 results over 2 minutes with no `retry-after`, stop and report. Post when the work is done, not a bare acknowledgement.
